name: Idempotent Task Replay
description: Task replay from the durable log produces identical results. Used for recovery and debugging.
purpose: Enable deterministic task replay for recovery, debugging, and audit without side-effect duplication.
acceptanceCriteria: Each task execution is durably logged with full input parameters
Replaying a task from the durable log produces identical results (idempotency)
Replay is used by the recovery controller for repair operations
Replay can be triggered manually for debugging and audit
Replay respects the same resource limits and deadlines as original execution
Replay results are distinguishable from original execution in logs
